minutes.headline: Commission continued two wetlands hearings to March 5, approved two Lake Shirley projects, and passed on a Chapter 61 parcel.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission heard introductions of two new notices of intent (Table Rock trailhead parking and a Northfield Road culvert/replication area), both continued to March 5 pending DEP file numbers. It approved a retaining wall/tree work notice at 352 Sunset Lane and a request for determination at 338 Sunset Lane. It also reviewed a Meadow Lane violation, scheduled an emergency executive session on 950 Chase Road, and unanimously declined to pursue a Chapter 61 parcel on Harbor Road.

public_comment.topic: Chair opened general public comment; no hands raised.
Asked where the existing small gravel parking area across from her driveway sits relative to the Table Rock plan and whether it would be kept or a crosswalk added.
Responded to the violation concern at the neighboring 48 Meadow Lane property, speaking from another person's computer; said items would be removed after snowmelt.

what_happened.line: The Commission voted to continue the Table Rock trailhead parking notice of intent at 994 Northfield Road to March 5, pending a DEP file number.
It also voted to continue the Latanzi notice of intent at 780 Northfield Road, a culvert replacement and replication area, to March 5.
The Commission approved the notice of intent at 352 Sunset Lane with standard conditions and work limited to the draw down period; one member recused.
It approved the request for determination at 338 Sunset Lane as presented, again with one member recused.
By consensus and with no vote, the Commission declined to pursue the Chapter 61 parcel at 100 Harbor Road, and set an emergency executive session on 950 Chase Road.

why_it_matters: The Chapter 61 parcel at 100 Harbor Road will not be pursued by the Commission, so that land is not on a path to town conservation ownership, and no vote was taken to record the decision.

Two Northfield Road projects stay open until March 5, and the 950 Chase Road encroachment is headed to a joint executive session with the Select Board, so abutters and nearby residents have more hearings ahead.
watch_next: March 5 hearings: the Table Rock and Latanzi notices of intent return once DEP file numbers are issued.
The emergency joint executive session with the Select Board on 950 Chase Road, set for Monday or Tuesday at 6 p.m.

The official minutes record no vote on either Northfield Road continuation and none of the dollar figures we heard. The one thing to know is that our minutes show two roll-call continuation votes the official minutes do not mention, and the official minutes carry a different continuation (90 Howard Street) that we did not capture.
